import pytest

from your_module import snake_to_camel


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("input_value", "expected"),
    [
        ("hello_world", "helloWorld"),
        ("hello_world_test", "helloWorldTest"),
        ("user_id", "userId"),
        ("alreadycamel", "alreadycamel"),
        ("alreadyCamel", "alreadyCamel"),
        ("HTTP_response_code", "HTTPResponseCode"),
        ("foo_bAR_bAz", "fooBarBaz"),
        ("version_2_update", "version2Update"),
        ("café_au_lait", "caféAuLait"),
    ],
)
def test_snake_to_camel_happy_paths(input_value, expected):
    assert snake_to_camel(input_value) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("input_value", "expected"),
    [
        ("", ""),
        ("_", ""),
        ("___", ""),
        ("_leading", "Leading"),
        ("trailing_", "trailing"),
        ("double__underscore", "doubleUnderscore"),
        ("many___underscores", "manyUnderscores"),
        ("__dunder__", "Dunder"),
    ],
)
def test_snake_to_camel_edge_cases(input_value, expected):
    assert snake_to_camel(input_value) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("bad_input", "expected_exception"),
    [
        (None, AttributeError),
        (123, AttributeError),
        (["hello_world"], AttributeError),
        ({"value": "hello_world"}, AttributeError),
        (b"hello_world", TypeError),
    ],
)
def test_snake_to_camel_invalid_input_types_raise(bad_input, expected_exception):
    with pytest.raises(expected_exception):
        snake_to_camel(bad_input)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
